modos.descricao: Personagem Silver Fang Ren13, ataca primeiro vs Wyrm

_metadata.texto_original: Jonas Albrecht has become the King of the Silver Fangs. When in combat with Wyrm creatures, Albrecht's Combat Actions are always resolved first. He may begin play equipped with a Grand Klaive.
